$comment: Facebook groups worth sharing into, verified from public group pages on 2026-11-06. Member counts drift; re-check when you join. Priority: 1 = post every relevant story, 2 = post when the story is in that town, 3 = low value, 0 = do not post.

groups.name: US 81 Corridor weather alerts and road conditions
groups.note: The most active road-weather group on the corridor. The name says US 81 but members post I-80 conditions from Brady to North Platte and statewide. Read the pinned rules before the first share.

groups.name: Nebraska Weather Network
groups.note: Run with meteorologists. Share warnings and corridor impacts, not general news. Always credit NWS in the post.

groups.name: Nebraska Road Conditions
groups.note: Small but exactly on topic: the group description is people asking about bad roads between North Platte and Omaha. Highest relevance per member of any group on this list.

groups.name: Life In Lincoln Nebraska
groups.note: Lincoln stories only. Public, so shares are visible without joining, but join before posting.

groups.name: What's Up Kearney
groups.note: Very active: 11 new posts on the day it was checked, about 630 a month. Private, so join first and follow the admin's posting rules.

groups.name: Kearney Activities Group
groups.note: Events and activities, not news. Use only for a genuinely useful Kearney service story (road work downtown, a closure people keep asking about).

groups.name: Hastings NE only events
groups.note: Events group. Same caution as Kearney Activities: only for a story people are actually asking about.

groups.name: You know you're from North Platte when....
groups.note: Nostalgia group, low activity (14 posts in the last month). Only worth posting when I-80 at North Platte is the story.

groups.name: Nebraska Severe Weather
groups.note: Run by a local meteorologist (Rusty Dawkins). Could not read members or rules without logging in. Open it once, confirm activity, then set access and members.

groups.name: Nebraska Panhandle weather alerts and road conditions
groups.note: The only Panhandle road-weather group found. Indexed posts confirm it is active. Login wall blocked the member count.

groups.name: Grand Island NE and surrounding area - Activities & Events
groups.note: The only Grand Island group surfaced. Small. If it is dead, search inside Facebook for 'Grand Island Nebraska' groups and add the active one.

groups.name: Omaha, and Council Bluffs discussion, classified and community group
groups.note: Metro group that spans both sides of the river, which suits the Omaha end of the corridor. Verify size and rules before posting.

groups.name: NEBRASKA Freight Brokers, Shippers, Carriers & Truck Drivers Group
groups.note: Industry group heavy with job ads. Only a full closure or chain-law story belongs here, framed as driver information.

groups.name: Things To Do In Omaha & Beyond
groups.note: Admin rules explicitly ban 'promoting your own group, newsletter or app' and AI-written posts. Do not post here.
